task: Frozen cosine-prototype assignment on five closely related BANKING77 intents

dataset.citation: Casanueva et al., Efficient Intent Detection with Dual Sentence Encoders (2020), NLP4ConvAI / ACL.
dataset.split_note: Original official test split used only for final evaluation; official train split stratified by seed 731 into fit, reference and validation.

model.instruction:
Instruct: Group short online-banking support messages by their specific customer intent, distinguishing related cash-withdrawal issues.
Query:
model.normalization: L2 unit vectors; cosine similarity by dot product

methods.cosine: Uncorrected cosine similarity to L2-normalized intent centroids.
methods.mean_baseline: cosine(q,c_k) - lambda * mean_{r in independent reference}(cosine(r,c_k)); lambda selected on validation macro-F1.
methods.csls: 2*cosine(q,c_k) - r_query(q) - r_candidate(c_k), with top-10 local neighbourhood averages; query-side term is constant across candidates for each query.

interpretation: Small domain-specific evaluation, not a general benchmark. The encoder was frozen; a label-centroid prototype was fitted on training examples, so this measures known-intent assignment, not unsupervised cluster discovery. No correction is presumed to help.
